import zipfile, re, datetime

for rel in rr:

sheets=[]
for sh in wb.find(M+'sheets'):
    sheets.append((sh.get('name'), rels[sh.get(R+'id')]))

def colnum(ref):
    c=re.match(r'([A-Z]+)', ref).group(1)
    n=0
    for ch in c: n=n*26+(ord(ch)-64)
    return n

out=open('/tmp/dump.tsv','w')
for name, target in sheets:
    path='xl/'+target if not target.startswith('/') else target[1:]
    ws=ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
    out.write('#### SHEET: '+name+'\\n')
    sd=ws.find(M+'sheetData')
    for row in sd:
        rn=row.get('r')

        for c in row:
            ref=c.get('r'); t=c.get('t')

            val=''

    out.write('\\n')
out.close()

var pym = `
import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
M='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
R='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}'
z=zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/sched.xlsx')
sst=[]
root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
for si in root:
    sst.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(M+'t')))
rels={}
for rel in ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels')): rels[rel.get('Id')]=rel.get('Target')
wb=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
sheets=[(sh.get('name'), rels[sh.get(R+'id')]) for sh in wb.find(M+'sheets')]
name, target = sheets[0]
ws=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/'+target))
# merged cells
mc = ws.find(M+'mergeCells')
print('MERGES:', [m.get('ref') for m in mc] if mc is not None else None)
out=open('/tmp/master.txt','w')
for row in ws.find(M+'sheetData'):
    rn=row.get('r'); items=[]
    for c in row:
        ref=c.get('r'); t=c.get('t'); v=c.find(M+'v'); isx=c.find(M+'is')
        val=''
        if t=='s' and v is not None: val=sst[int(v.text)]
        elif t=='inlineStr' and isx is not None: val=''.join(x.text or '' for x in isx.iter(M+'t'))
        elif v is not None: val=v.text
        val=(val or '').strip().replace('\\n',' / ')
        if val: items.append(ref+'='+val)
    if items: out.write('R'+rn+': '+' | '.join(items)+'\\n')
out.close()
print(open('/tmp/master.txt').read()[:100])
`;
